newsitem.title: USA: Midland Realty files for $150 mln mortgage certs.
newsitem.headline: Midland Realty files for $150 mln mortgage certs.

text.p: Midland Realty Acceptance Corp said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $150 million in mortgage pass-through certificates.
When combined with previous registrations, Midland will have a total offering of up to $575,261,000 in mortgage certificates, the filing said.
Net proceeds from the sale will be used by the company to pay the purchase price of the mortgage loans, to repay indebtedness that has been incurred to obtain funds to acquire the mortgage loans.
Proceeds will also be used to pay costs of structuring, issuing and underwriting the certificates, the filins said.
The offering is being underwritten by Prudential Securities Inc.
Midland Realty, of Kansas City, Missouri, is a wholly-owned subsidieary of Midland Loan Services L.P.
